summary.classification: BARC Agri-Advisory Portal API response; not yet reconciled with the project page final 76-crop assessment inventory
summary.area_units: API response did not expose a unit field; confirm area unit from BARC data dictionary before public display
caveats: API directory count (483) differs from BARC project page suitability assessment coverage (464 upazilas) and AGRIVA administrative directory (495).
API returned 95 distinct crop names, not 76. The crop inventory and assessment vintage must be reconciled with BARC before production use.
BARC API upazila_code is a different code system from AGRIVA IDs; use the reviewed crosswalk, not numeric concatenation.
Two BARC records labelled Gazipur City Corporation and Rangpur City Corporation have no one-to-one AGRIVA upazila equivalent.
Area field units were not explicit in the API payload inspected. Do not label them hectares until BARC confirms.
This is suitability class area, not a yield forecast or profitability ranking.
